{{Quote|Kidnapped from here? I thought this palace was supposed to be secure.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="XWRS28" />}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eiattu 6]] to escort [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], who was posing as [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] while the real Organa was on a covert mission to [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]] to negotiate interim [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage's]] defection to the New Republic.

Upon arrival at Eiattu, the team was met by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rial Pernon]]. After a ceremony, both Tycho and Winter were stunned by a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] team sent to take Leia prisoner. As the Rebels ponder how Winter and Tycho were kidnapped, the two were brought before Lionia Tavira, who was trying to create her own Warlordship. On Eiattu, Fel said he was on a secret Imperial mission and learnt from Count [[Arian Laabann]] that it was he who arranged Leonia's capture of Leia and Tycho.

The Rebels then headed for [[StarForge Station]] where they learnt from [[Rayt (smuggler)|Rayt]] that "Leia" and Tycho were being held on Axxila.
